column1: # This file is the authored list of what the release archive contains. `ds-check inventory`
# proves it against exports.tsv (every export and every stylesheet the exports import, and
# nothing else), adapter-exports.tsv, the surface tables, and Git's tracked files.
# `release/assemble.sh` expands it, adds checksums, and writes MANIFEST.tsv into the
# archive; `ds-check release` verifies the unpacked archive against that manifest.
#   public-preview  a compatibility surface consumers may depend on (CSS, surface tables)
#   documentation   explanatory or legal text; carries no compatibility promise
# Kinds: css, surface, doc, license, tool
# Transforms: none (byte-identical to the source), identity (substitute release identity
#   placeholders), tailwind-core-import (rewrite the one repository-relative core import to ./core.css).
# The CSS layout is the staged public-export shape: each export under its declared name,
# imported stylesheets beside it. No repository path survives into the archive.
